name: io.github.jefboneta/sensortensor
description: Documentation-search MCP server with a feedback loop that reveals gaps in your docs.

environment_variables.name: SENSORTENSOR_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Base URL of your documentation-search API (must expose /health, /openapi.json and /search).

environment_variables.name: SENSORTENSOR_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Optional Bearer token if your API requires authentication.
